entries.role: Persistent virtual browser fingerprint and cookie client
behavior_notes: Build always creates ~/.ogame/storage/<name> before loading its persistor; successful existing loads override new fingerprint settings/UA, while any load error triggers new fingerprint creation. File fingerprint is a positional JSON array, saved0644 within directories created0755.

GetBlackbox performs a real game1.js request, updates date/elapsed timing, rotates XVec, saves, then obfuscates the serialized array; it is not a pure formatter. WithClient swaps a shared client without local locking.

ParseBlackbox and version parsers index arrays without checking length; empty/short arrays panic. Empty EncryptBlackbox/DecryptBlackbox panic, and V8 marshaling does not match V8 parsing. Offline harness reproduces these cases without disk or network.

Random defaults are incomplete for selectable OS/browser combinations: memory auto-population exists only for Android, concurrency/color/screen omit Linux, and vendor auto-population is mainly Chrome or iOS Safari. Available CLI choices are not guarantees that fresh fingerprints can be built for every combination.

entries.role: Lobby authentication, challenge and account-management client
